_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: With the score moving ±2+ points only 3% of the time historically and both brains seeing a coil rather than a breakout, HOLD is the statistically honest call until either ETF flows resume or VIX breaks 22 with a funding spike.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst grades HOLD/CAUTION with medium conviction citing conflicting signals; narrative implies imminent UP reversal via mean-reversion squeeze. Split on direction, aligned on coil compression.
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows return above 30 daily and BTC momentum sustains above 55 (analyst's breaker for UP); or VIX breaks 22 with funding >0.01% and BTC loses $60K (breaker for DOWN)
next_move.invalidated_if: Score remains flat (24-31 band) for 5+ days with no ETF flow or VIX resolution — coil persists and HOLD continues to be correct
